description: This PHP script is designed to perform a sample test for deleting a test project in the TestLink API. It requires external utility and sample inclusion files, initializes parameters including devKey and prefix, creates an IXR_Client instance, and invokes runTest to execute the deleteTestProject method.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class presumably for XML-RPC communication with the TestLink server.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Function to execute a test method via the IXR client with specified arguments.
